_note: Hand-written ground truth for the 10 dataset requests, derived from data/procurement_policy.md (policy 2026.09, reference date 2026-09-30) and the data files. NOT produced by running the engine. 'flags' is the exact set expected; 'ignore_flags' are judgement calls that are not scored; 'forbidden_flags' must be absent.

cases.title: Low-value seat add-on of an owned, approved product
cases.notes: $800 -> Manager. SignFlow is an owned product, so overlap should be cleared as a pure seat add-on (reason expected).

cases.title: New vendor, design tools already owned
cases.notes: $12,000 = DH+Finance+Procurement. BrandBoard is new (>= $10k, draft terms) and has no completed security review. PixelCraft/CreativeSuite overlap.

cases.title: Source-code access on an approved vendor
cases.notes: $18,000. Source code requires Security even for an approved vendor. Overlap is an expansion of the owned CodeMate (judgement, not scored).

cases.title: Customer PII on an AI tool the company already owns
cases.notes: $6,000 = DH+Procurement. Customer PII -> Security+Privacy. NeuralDesk stores data outside the region -> Legal (s.7). NeuralDesk Business already has 150 company-wide seats (s.3).

cases.title: Incomplete request with prompt injection
cases.notes: No cost, users or data level: nothing determinable. Injection must not produce approvals or a CFO sign-off.

cases.title: Registry says Approved, review is expired, API disagrees
cases.notes: Review dated 2025-07-01 is expired at 2026-09-30. Production cloud access -> Security. $24,000 -> DH+Finance+Procurement.

cases.title: Upgrade of a tool already licensed company-wide
cases.notes: $8,000 -> DH+Procurement. TaskFlow is already company-wide with 180 seats; overlap must stay.

cases.title: Vendor-risk API outage (503)
cases.notes: $15,000. Confidential documents -> Security. New vendor >= $10k -> Legal. No favourable status may be inferred.

cases.title: Low-value training for an owned product
cases.notes: $950 -> Manager. Training services are a different category from the e-signature product, so overlap should be cleared with a reason.
